err: too_many_lines (31 lines).reason: V3 MUST-FIX: >30 lines is too_many_lines, not empty_cart. Baseline conflated the 0-lines and >30-lines checks into one empty_cart branch; the checkout.error_too_many_lines i18n string was unreachable in production and demo/server parity was broken.

limit: one-character name.reason: Length limits (shared contract; mirrors checkout schema name 2-60): a 1-character name is now 400 invalid_customer. Baseline accepted any non-blank name.

limit: over-length address (161).reason: Length limits (shared contract; address 4-160): 161 chars is now 400 invalid_customer. Baseline had no string caps (A2 tamper: oversized payload).

limit: over-length notes (501).reason: Length limits (shared contract; notes <= 500): 501 chars is now 400 invalid_customer. Baseline had no cap.

versionSizes: player 4XL.reason: A2-B4 fix: size must be valid for the selected version (versionSizes, same rule as sizeOptionsFor). Player is S-2XL, so 4XL is now 400 invalid_size; baseline only checked product.sizes and accepted it at 179.

badge-active: column inactive but data a.reason: A2-B10 fix: badge is active only when the patches.active COLUMN is true (the storefront's source: listBadges active=eq.true + RLS) and data.active is not false. Baseline preferred data.active, so this storefront-hidden badge was accepted.

promo tie-break: equal sort_order, DB re.reason: A2-B11 fix: campaigns ordered by sortOrder then id, exactly like src/lib/promotions.ts activePromotion. With equal sortOrder p-a (20%) now wins over p-b (40%); baseline took whichever row the DB returned first.

locale: invalid locale.reason: A2-B9 fix: locale outside ar/he/en is now 400 invalid_locale before any DB write. Baseline passed it through; in production the orders.locale CHECK then failed the insert as 500 internal_error (the harness has no CHECK, hence the frozen 200).

locale: missing locale.reason: A2-B9 fix: a missing locale is now 400 invalid_locale. Baseline stored the order with no data.locale (column fell back to the DB default 'ar'). The storefront always sends a locale.

allowlist: customer extra keys and white.reason: Allowlist + trim fix (A2 tamper: extra fields persisted verbatim): only name/email/phone/city/address/notes are stored, trimmed like the checkout schema; isAdmin and a spoofed customerId are dropped. Pricing unchanged.

allowlist: personalization extra keys.reason: Allowlist fix: only personalization name/number are stored; priceIls and html keys are dropped. Personalization stays free, pricing unchanged.

version: non-empty version on a product.reason: A2 tamper row 'Invalid version' fix: a non-empty version for a product without versions is now 400 invalid_version. Baseline ignored it for price but stored it in supplier-hold items.

personalization: name with digits.reason: Personalization contract (shared contract; ProductPage rule: 1-14 letters, marks, space, apostrophe, dot or hyphen): a name with digits is now 400 invalid_personalization. Baseline only checked length <= 14.
